title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Good morning. I have to write about shortstops and Rule 5 possibilities. For SS, usual suspects? (Hechavarria, Mercer, Escobar, Tim Beckham?) For Rule 5, should I focus on pitchers?

Yes All those SS are in play Rule 5 does not look promising right now. If we pick at all it will probably be a flyer on a pitcher and he would have to have a real good spring for us to keep. No quotes please. Hope this is helpful
